name: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS: VAMPIRE LORD ON NIGHTMARE STEED
description: Vampire Lords on Nightmare Steeds carve gory paths through the enemy with each thundering charge. The beast’s ironshod hooves cave in chests and grind foes into the mud, while the undead cavalier astride it lays about themself with a blade or axe, opening throats with every blow.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds a Vampire Lord on Nightmare Steed, a cruel leader for your Soulblight Gravelords armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Seated atop a nightmare, they are able to keep up with the fastest elements of your army, making them ideal to lead your thunderous cavalry charges. The kit includes two head options for the nightmare, three head options for the lord, and a choice of an axe or a sword as a weapon, making it easy to customise your blood-hungry leader.</br></br>This kit comprises 21 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 80mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
